description: Android activity class for a business card app, allowing users to pick a contact and display their name and phone number.

classes.name: BusinessCardActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages contact selection and display of contact info.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and sets click listener for contact picking.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from contact picker and initiates contact info loading.

methods.name: loadContactInfo
methods.description: Loads contact info asynchronously on a background thread.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Displays contact's name and phone number in the UI.
